mainEntity.name: Is Pac-Man free to play on Mindhack.in?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, it's completely free and runs directly in your browser - no download or account needed.
Use your keyboard's arrow keys on desktop, or the on-screen touch controls on mobile, to guide Pac-Man through the maze.

mainEntity.name: What's the goal of the game?

acceptedAnswer.text: Eat every dot in the maze while avoiding the four ghosts. Grab a power pellet in a corner and you can turn the tables and eat the ghosts instead, for a short time.
